title: Rankings | a16z Top 100 Consumer AI Apps: ByteDance Surges, ChatGPT Pressured, New AI Categories Rise
summary: Ingest note: ~9 CN charts (full Top boards). EN keeps methodology headlines + named ranks from body — attach or redraw tables on import.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Ranking / Digest · August 27, 2024 · Source: a16z consumer AI Top 50 web + mobile (every 6 months); contributor Olivia Moore, a16z Consumer partner

Ingest note: ~9 CN charts (full Top boards). EN keeps methodology headlines + named ranks from body — attach or redraw tables on import.

In crowded consumer AI, shipping efficiency tools is not enough — the question is which apps earn real habit. a16z’s semi-annual data cut surfaces Top 50 web and mobile apps and the trends under them: rising categories, new rivals, shifting engagement.

Creative tools dominate

Web: 52% of companies on content create/edit (image, video, music, voice). Of 12 newcomers, 58% are creative. First-time Top-5 newcomers: four creatives — Luma #14, Viggle #21, SeaArt #29, Udio #33. Biggest mover: music generator Suno #36 → #5. Image tools’ share of top content sites fell to 41%; SeaArt the only pure-image tool among five new top creatives. Video/music newcomers: Luma, Viggle, Vidnoz, Udio.

Mobile: photo/video edit is #2 category at 22%. Top new mobile names often legacy tools gone AI-native — Meitu #9, SNOW #30, Adobe Express #35.

ChatGPT under pressure

ChatGPT still #1 on web and mobile for a third cycle — but assistants crowd in. Perplexity → web #3; Similarweb avg visit >7 min (slightly above ChatGPT); first time in mobile Top 50. Claude web #10 → #4; Artifacts vs GPTs. Mobile: Luzia debuts #25 — claims 45M global users, mostly Spanish; started as WhatsApp bot, independent app Dec 2023.

ByteDance’s AI push

Three web debuts: Gauth #44, Coze #45, Doubao #47. Doubao also mobile #26. Plus Hypic #19 and Cici #34 — six slots across boards. Cici = Doubao’s English mobile twin. Engine: Flow genAI unit (late 2023) shipping under varied brands in U.S./overseas since early 2024.

New categories: looks & dating

Only new categories on web+mobile: photo aesthetics + dating. Mobile debuts: LooksMax AI #43, Umax #44, RIZZ #49. LooksMax/Umax score/improve looks from uploads (LooksMax also voice attractiveness); claims >2M / >1M users. Subs: Umax $4.99/wk (or invite 3 friends free); LooksMax $3.99/wk. RIZZ: dating-chat coach from screenshots/profiles with one-tap paste replies.

Discord as growth signal

Discord invite traffic foreshadows ranking climbs — sandbox then graduate (Suno left Discord top list this cycle). Midjourney still #1 Discord invite traffic. As of July: 10 AI cos in Discord invite Top 100 (half new vs January). Of Discord Top 10 servers: half let users generate in-Discord (often paid); half for community/support/resources.

Thesis close: AI-native products grow and deepen engagement at unprecedented speed — AI will mint the next decade’s category leaders.

— END —
